Container.Name: fwupd-webui
Container.Overview:
Read-only firmware inventory for your server. Lists every device fwupd can see — NVMe drives, HBAs, network cards, Thunderbolt controllers, docks — with its current firmware version and any updates available from LVFS.
This container does not flash anything. It requires privileged mode and host access to /sys, /dev and /run/udev in order to enumerate hardware.

Config.Name: sysfs
Config.Description: Required: fwupd reads device attributes from sysfs

Config.Name: devices
Config.Description: Required: NVMe and SCSI ioctls need the host device nodes

Config.Name: udev database
Config.Description: Required: without this the device list comes back empty

Config.Name: Metadata cache
Config.Description: Persists downloaded LVFS metadata across restarts

Config.Name: Metadata refresh interval (hours)
Config.Description: How old LVFS metadata may be before startup refetches it
